stories.story_fr: Les marges brutes du transport aérien ont augmenté séquentiellement grâce à une meilleure rentabilité par kilo.
stories.story_en: Airfreight gross margins increased sequentially from the fourth quarter of 2025 on higher per‑kilo profitability.
stories.quote: Airfreight gross margins increased sequentially from the fourth quarter of 2025 on higher per‑kilo profitability

stories.story_fr: Le cash retourné aux actionnaires sous forme de rachats d'actions s'est élevé à 288 millions de dollars au premier trimestre 2026.
stories.story_en: Cash returned to shareholders in the form of share repurchases was $288 million in Q1 2026.
stories.quote: Cash returned to shareholders in the form of share repurchases was $288 million

stories.story_fr: Le conseil d'administration a approuvé un nouveau programme de rachat d'actions de 3 milliards de dollars.
stories.story_en: Our Board of Directors approved a new $3 billion share repurchase program.
stories.quote: Our Board of Directors approved a new $3 billion share repurchase program

stories.story_fr: Les services de douane, Transcon, distribution et gestion des commandes ont tous enregistré une croissance à deux chiffres du chiffre d'affaires.
stories.story_en: Customs, Transcon, Distribution, and Order Management each achieved double‑digit revenue growth.
stories.quote: Customs, Transcon, Distribution, and Order Management each achieved double‑digit revenue growth

stories.story_fr: Expeditors prévoit des investissements stratégiques dans l'intelligence artificielle et d'autres solutions verticales à fort potentiel de croissance.
stories.story_en: We will also make strategic investments in high‑return opportunities, such as artificial intelligence (AI) and other customer vertical solutions.
